title: Lightweight API workflows fetch their script with curl at GITHUB_SHA instead of actions/checkout
answers: why does the approval workflow spend seconds on actions/checkout before the bot runs
replace sparse actions/checkout with curl to fetch a single workflow script
fetch one .js file from the repo at the event commit in a GitHub Actions workflow
body:
Symptom: Label, PR-size, patch, advice, team-review, release-note and approval-gate bot jobs spend noticeable time and occasionally stall before the bot logic runs.
Root cause: .github/workflows/labeling.yml, pr-size.yml, patch.yml, advice.yml, team-review.yml, release-note.yml and approval.yml each used actions/checkout with sparse-checkout of .github just to read one script; the checkout action download dominated job time.
Fix pattern: Replace the checkout step with a named 'Fetch script' step that curls https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/$GITHUB_SHA/.github/workflows/<name>.js into the workspace root, then require('./<name>.js') from actions/github-script. approval.yml instead runs mkdir -p .github/workflows and writes approval.js there, passing REPO and SHA through env from github.repository and github.sha.
Constraints: Fetch by $GITHUB_SHA, not a branch, so the script matches the commit that fired the event. Only applies to workflows that need just one script file; workflows that need a full checkout are unaffected. .claude/rules/github-actions.md prefers sparse-checkout for subsets; the curl path is a deliberate exception, and reviewers flagged that it adds an unauthenticated raw-content download. approval.yml keeps its pull-requests: read permissions and concurrency unchanged.
Applies: Workflows under .github/workflows that run API-only logic via actions/github-script and need no repository tree, including the approval gate workflow.

search: Lightweight API workflows under .github/workflows fetch their execution script via curl at $GITHUB_SHA instead of running actions/checkout. In workflows like approval.yml, labeling.yml, and team-review.yml, replacing actions/checkout with a 'Fetch script' step eliminates checkout download delays before running actions/github-script. Scripts must be fetched by $GITHUB_SHA rather than a branch, which is a deliberate exception to .claude/rules/github-actions.md that applies only to workflows requiring a single script.
